title: Proposal
description: Workflow format introduced 2026-09-25. Metadata is authoritative YAML; external artifacts carry content identity.

x-required-reasons.refuted_candidate: repair lineage names the refuted candidate artifact
x-required-reasons.counterexample_record: repair lineage names the proof record that holds the counterexample
x-required-reasons.round: repair lineage names the repair round
x-required-reasons.reverted_repair: repair lineage carries the reverted-repair flag from the contract-match check

repair_lineage.description: Probata ticket 12 (2026-10-14 ET): on the proposal of a candidate artifact that counterexample-guided repair (ticket 13) made. swdb.proof.validate_proposal checks that the record is a refutation with an inline counterexample about the refuted candidate artifact.

refuted_candidate.description: The refuted candidate artifact this proposal repairs.

counterexample_record.description: The refuted proof record that holds the counterexample inline.

round.x-reason: a repair round is a positive integer (the round cap belongs to the method version's budgets, ticket 13)

reverted_repair.description: The deterministic contract-match check's flag: true when the repaired code no longer applies the refuted candidate's contract (map decision 23 item 3). A reverted repair may compete and never counts as a repair.
